spots.name: Poison Springs Lookout Tower
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Gurdon Light
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Ruby Street
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Rocky Mound Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 130 m (427 ft).
